column1: # Spoken Bangla surah names and their Bangla meanings, one row per surah.
# Source: Bangla Wikipedia, "কুরআনের সূরার তালিকা" (https://bn.wikipedia.org/wiki/কুরআনের_সূরার_তালিকা), revision 9164874, retrieved 2026-10-24.
# Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); the app credits it in docs/packs.md and the About screen.
# Columns, tab separated: surah number, spoken name, meaning. A blank meaning means the source gives none (20, 36).
# Mechanical changes from the source: article joined with a hyphen (আল-), invisible joiners and "সূরা" prefixes removed, doubled vowel signs and comma spacing fixed.

# Names changed on purpose: 22 (hajj spelling as in its meaning), 27 (নম্‌ল to নামল, print usage), 39 (আয-যুমার, the spelling of the source's own page title), 52 (hyphen), 83 (article আল and the page title's spelling; the table has আত).
